purpose: Re-check the enable_all_pad_tree=True promotion gate now that docs/plans/2026-07-24-001-fix-forced-segment-fail-closed-plan.md has landed. Neither existing regression test (test_golden_board_routing_drc_regression, test_production_board_routing_drc_regression) actually calls route_pcb() with enable_all_pad_tree=True -- both exercise only the False default regardless of intent -- so this measurement calls route_pcb() directly with the flag set.
gate: unconnected_items <= 260 on production, == 0 on corpus (docs/plans/2026-07-22-001 R14; criteria originally set in docs/solutions/architecture-patterns/router-v6-all-pad-tree-default-off-2026-07-19.md)

production_comparison.delta: Enabling the pad tree changes unconnected_items by only -4 (326 -> 322) on the real board -- both mechanisms are failing on nearly the same net set. Plain A* fails with 'no legal path found (forced segment disallowed)'; the tree executor fails the same nets with 'no legal tree edge'. Neither is a forced-segment/fabrication problem anymore (both correctly fail closed); this is a genuine routing-capacity/congestion gap on this board's current channel/grid setup.

corpus_measurement.reason: solve_placement() raised UnresolvedConstraintRefsError (unresolved named critical-loop constraint refs: commutation_loop, gate_drive_high, gate_drive_low) in this standalone measurement script -- the equivalent pytest test downgrades this via monkeypatch.setattr(encoder, "_UNRESOLVED_REF_POLICY", "warn") inside the pytest fixture lifecycle, which this ad-hoc script did not correctly replicate. Not pursued further because the production result alone already fails the gate -- the gate requires both criteria, so corpus's result cannot change the verdict.

verdict: GATE FAILS. Production unconnected_items=322 exceeds the <=260 threshold, and completion (3.45%) is not meaningfully different from the enable_all_pad_tree=False case (0%) -- turning the flag on does not close a fabrication-vs-honesty gap (both paths already fail closed correctly), it exposes a genuine routing-capacity gap: the router's current channel/grid capability cannot legally route most of this board's nets either way. Do NOT promote enable_all_pad_tree to default-on. The blocking work is upstream of this flag -- better corridor/channel routing capacity, congestion-aware ordering, or board-level channel width increases -- not a promotion decision this flag alone can satisfy.
